04 / methodology

How We Compared XMR to ETH Exchange Services

We reviewed services that displayed a working Monero-to-Ethereum route on November 3, 2026. Every service was assessed using the same seven criteria. We prioritized the complete user journey rather than selecting a winner from a single headline fee or marketing claim.

Live crypto quotes change from minute to minute. A fair price check uses the same XMR input, the same rate type and a narrow time window. Because a static quote would become outdated quickly, this page explains how to repeat the comparison immediately before exchanging.

How to compare live quotes yourself

  1. Open each service within the same 10–15 minute window.
  2. Enter the same XMR amount on every service.
  3. Select the same rate type where possible.
  4. Record the estimated ETH output before sending funds.
  5. Check whether network and service costs are already included.
  6. Compare the live minimum and expected completion conditions.
  7. Recheck the wallet address and final estimate before choosing a provider.

Limitations

Our review used publicly available service information and route-level forms. We did not send a real deposit through every provider. A displayed estimate is not the same as a completed-transaction result, particularly in floating-rate mode.

Why ChangeNOW won

ChangeNOW achieved the strongest combined score. It did not need to be the top service in every individual category. Its first-place result came from offering the direct route, two rate modes, an upfront estimate, broad coverage, no published upper swap limit, a simple three-step process and 24/7 support in one product.

05 / execution

How to Exchange Monero for Ethereum on ChangeNOW

The standard XMR-to-ETH flow has three main exchange stages, plus a final address and amount check before you start. You need a Monero wallet with enough XMR for the deposit and an Ethereum-compatible wallet address for receiving native ETH.

  1. 1

    Select Monero and Ethereum

    Open the XMR-to-ETH exchange page. Choose Monero as the asset you send and Ethereum as the asset you receive. Enter the XMR amount. The form will display the live minimum and estimated ETH output.

  2. 2

    Choose a rate mode

    Use floating mode if you want the exchange to follow current market conditions. Choose fixed mode when it is available and receiving the agreed amount matters more than tracking short-term market movement. Read the conditions shown in the live form.

  3. 3

    Enter your Ethereum address

    Paste the destination ETH address from your own wallet. Compare the first and last characters with the original address. Confirm that the exchange form is sending native ETH on the Ethereum network. Do not enter a Monero address or select a wrapped ETH version on another network by mistake.

  4. 4

    Review, send XMR and track the exchange

    Confirm the pair, amount, rate mode and ETH address. Send the required Monero amount to the generated deposit address. If the sending wallet asks for transaction details, follow the instructions shown in the live exchange form. Keep the exchange ID and follow the status until the native ETH payout reaches your wallet.

Important: A crypto exchange cannot normally be cancelled after you send the deposit. Blockchain transfers are irreversible, so verify every field before sending XMR.

06 / chains

What Changes When You Exchange XMR for ETH?

Monero and Ethereum are separate assets on separate blockchains. Exchanging XMR for ETH is not a transfer between two addresses on the same network. The service receives Monero and sends native Ethereum to the destination address you provide.

Monero compared with Ethereum in an exchange
FeatureMonero (XMR)Ethereum (ETH)
Blockchain visibilityPrivacy features conceal sender, recipient and amount dataAddresses, transfers and amounts are publicly visible on-chain
Address typeMonero-compatible addressEthereum-compatible 0x address
Asset role in this exchangeDeposit assetPayout asset
Main user checkCorrect XMR deposit amount and exchange instructionsCorrect ETH address and Ethereum network
ReversibilityBlockchain transfers are irreversibleBlockchain transfers are irreversible

Does exchanging XMR to ETH preserve Monero-level privacy?

No. Monero and Ethereum have different privacy models. Monero is designed to conceal transaction details within its network, while a standard Ethereum transfer is publicly visible. After the exchange, the ETH payout address, transferred amount and subsequent on-chain activity can be viewed through an Ethereum block explorer.

The exchange service may also retain operational records and apply legal or risk-based controls under its policies. Do not describe an XMR-to-ETH exchange as anonymous or untraceable. The accurate statement is that the source asset uses Monero’s privacy-focused network, while the destination asset enters Ethereum’s transparent public ledger.

07 / rates

XMR to ETH Rates, Fees and Exchange Time

Exchange rate

The XMR-to-ETH rate shows how much Ethereum you can receive for a given amount of Monero. It changes with market prices, liquidity and the selected rate mode.

Included costs

ChangeNOW states that all costs are built into the estimate shown before the swap, with no additional charge added after the exchange. Compare final ETH output rather than a headline fee alone.

Processing time

ChangeNOW publishes an overall average exchange time of about one minute, but an XMR-to-ETH swap can take longer because it starts after the required Monero confirmations and depends on network and liquidity conditions.

Fixed rate or floating rate?

A floating rate follows the market while the exchange is processed, so the final ETH amount can differ from the initial estimate. A fixed rate is designed to preserve the agreed output when the exchange conditions are met. Fixed mode may use a different estimate because the provider takes on short-term rate risk.

Choose based on your priority: potential market movement in floating mode or greater output certainty in fixed mode. Always read the live terms before sending XMR.

Is there a minimum or maximum amount?

The live minimum changes with the pair, network costs and liquidity. ChangeNOW says minimum amounts can be as low as the equivalent of $2, but the XMR-to-ETH form is the authoritative source for the current transaction. ChangeNOW does not publish an upper limit for standard crypto-to-crypto swaps.

08 / safety

XMR to ETH Safety Checklist

Complete these checks before sending Monero. Most address and network mistakes cannot be reversed.

  • Confirm that XMR is the deposit asset and ETH is the payout asset.
  • Use an Ethereum-compatible receiving wallet that you control.
  • Confirm that the payout is native ETH on the Ethereum network.
  • Copy the ETH address instead of typing it manually.
  • Compare the first and last characters after pasting the address.
  • Review the live minimum and estimated ETH output.
  • Check whether you selected a fixed or floating rate.
  • Send exactly the amount requested by the exchange form.
  • Save the exchange ID until the ETH payout arrives.
  • Consider a smaller test exchange when the transaction size justifies it.
  • Contact support through the service’s official domain only.

Never send funds based on an address received through an unsolicited message, social-media reply or search advertisement. Start from the official exchange page and verify the domain.
